# Functional completion: final proposed execution plan, version 1

Complete the remaining software corrections and evidence work under the existing remediate-all authority. Start the bounded truth and provenance inventories after this plan has three actual R3 acceptances. Run support/browser investigation independently while source-review gates remain held. No finding is closed by this plan, and no source worker starts merely because an author/reviewer reservation exists.

The full fourteen-issue crosswalk, thirty packages, sixty-five units and original per-unit acceptance are embedded in FINAL_PACKET.json. Their old status and qualification fields are dated history. The decisions and current staffing below govern future work; old provider labels do not confer competence. Source analysis is fixed at 9b783d72; the accepted component is exactly e54228c0/78295ecd and remains unwired. Actual launch bases are the then-published integration descendant after dependencies, recorded once. Reviews use the exact delivered commit.

## Decisions from peer challenge

1. Keep the original WS first-authorship NOT_GRANTED/WSR03 and privacy Opus/M3 FAILs unchanged. Reject immediate Opus-authored handler wiring. Corrected-component acceptance did not grant authorship competence. D6 remains held at its complete existing target; no smaller trailer-free runtime slice discharges or grants review of the mixed handler/component/app target. Trailer presence and absence are indicators, never affirmative native-family proof.
2. Adopt a prospective first MiniMax full lifecycle-review assessment for WS, a separate first MiniMax HA-review assessment, and a first Opus UI-behavior review assessment, each ONLY after its actual family/domain/role attempt audit, exact target/native contribution/conflict audit, useful competence match and qualified independent judge match pass. Astra is the proposed report-quality judge; its existing async/report judgments do not automatically grant HA/UI judging competence. An unproved judge or target holds that row. No novel-bug quota; known planning findings alone cannot earn PASS. Each assessment has one candidate and one exact judge, all six frozen axes, no assessment correction/retake/extra judge. Product corrections after an actual qualified source review have a separate one-fix/one-rereview reserve.
3. Prefer M3 over Anthropic for complete WS and HA review because the consequential target has actual Anthropic contributions or unresolved historical indicators. Anthropic UI remains conditional on affirmative non-self-authorship of the precise reviewed changes/context. An exact new-diff review can be legitimate with disclosed old context and no certification of the historical subsystem, but it cannot replace D6 or the required whole-chain privacy review. Unknown source family is recorded and resolved, never treated as clean. Assessment target and primary source-review target are separately frozen before dispatch. Published planning findings are not implementation authorship and do not by themselves disqualify a useful first review assessment; live discriminating controls and honest full-context reasoning are required.
4. WS policy: per connection one admitted read task, with one Boolean trailing-demand flag. A request received during a read may be satisfied only by a read started after that request. No cross-owner sharing of an already-started read and no global reply-task set. The accepted WsRequestWork component stays byte-identical; wiring owns the flag/loop. Application admission limit is 4; clients are already separately bounded. When application admission cannot succeed, return a distinct documented busy error through the existing bounded send queue; do not call the rejected factory or start retry tasks. One owner can do successive fresh reads while demand continues, so the two-read assertion applies ONLY to a finite burst held behind one pending read, not to an arbitrary long stream. At least one scheduling opportunity follows each completed read. A queued command must not be overtaken by this owner's later trailing read; test deterministic lock/event order and a two-second simulator progress deadline AFTER the held read is released. This is a software test threshold, not a physical latency claim. If implementation cannot preserve these invariants, return for contract/design review rather than weaken a test. Both application overload and coalescing/freshness are documented in the coordinator-owned contract in the same reviewed candidate. Preserve existing JSON schemas; edit schema only if a real shape change is proposed and reviewed.
5. WS lifecycle must fence admission before stream/runtime resources are released, for direct app cleanup, direct RestApiServer.stop, runtime stop, startup rollback and repeated stop. Close cancels/drains only that connection; cooperative work reaches remaining=0, resistant work remains truthfully tracked/reported. Test two apps, two sockets, blocked reads, 1000-frame finite bursts, cancellation/factory windows, slow-reader queues, errors, ping and command progress. Modify the existing unwired guard explicitly; retain all other accepted component tests. Callers' double-send and timed-out-sync recovery are part of acceptance; application-busy errors must not be misreported as matrix-read failures. Any bounded caller recovery needed gets an exact serial lease and complete qualified review, never hidden retry loops.
6. HA: a dedicated strict bare-JSON auth_status reader, retaining the existing envelope parser. Authenticate the proposed effective key without ambient session/remembered cookies and without any mutating request/PIN/login. Wrong/missing/revoked credentials on a locked hub give correctable errors; unlocked/no-key and an offline matrix remain supported. An explicitly supplied invalid key is rejected when capability can determine that, including unlocked hubs. Setup/options/reconfigure validate the same effective value; omitted preserves, explicit empty removes, reconfigure updates/removes stale options overrides, reload actually uses the validated header. Preserve polling options/unique identity/duplicate and wrong-device handling. Unsupported auth-status 404 is explicitly capability-unknown legacy compatibility, with a tested logged branch; timeout/malformed/5xx never becomes an authenticated PASS. Existing-supported legacy behavior may remain explicitly limited; do not silently revise a support claim. Automatic reauth from arbitrary write401 is outside this minimal repair; retain manual correctable recovery. A later positively classified setup auth/reauth extension requires its own scoped acceptance. Real hass and disposable real-HA locked-simulator cases, cookie contamination controls, zero-write assertions, real generated bare fixtures and failure rollback are required.
7. UI: keyboard s opens the existing visible General settings controller (unifiedSettings General), 4 selects actual visible Profiles/Scenes navigation, and shifted ? opens help under a declared keyboard layout. Preserve absent/unpinned navigation preferences with a documented no-op when unavailable. Do not invoke the legacy SettingsPanel or merely open the Control Deck. Confirm visible controls before editing. Real keys, modifiers, editable descendants, repeated/default-prevented events, mobile/desktop duplicated buttons, focus and exactly-topmost Escape behavior need browser effect tests and sensitivity controls. Keep broad overlay/a11y changes in CR09 unless a minimal CR03 assertion proves a necessary overlap. No baseline edits or visual approval inferred from passing tests.
8. Truth inventory maps every parser-open ID and all268 feature contracts to actual source/client/image/ancestry/assertions; distinguish resolved/partial/reproduce/hardware/owner and preserve HIL09's twelve caps. Reconcile the disputed UI/KIO counts from the registry rather than selecting a report number. Software viewport probes may run now; actual-device confirmation is a separate gate. Kiosk zoom is a technical design choice within existing scope; changed rendering/visual baseline approval remains owner-only. No owner question is required merely to investigate or propose it.
9. Test declared support floors before proposing policy changes: exact HA2025.1.0 and selected-current HA with immutable digests, plus the hub package independently under Python3.11. Upstream HA2025.1.0 metadata requires Python>=3.12.0 (verified primary-source copy retained by OpenAI); do not repeat the M3 report's 3.13 claim or attempt HA on3.11. A post-run import probe is not in-run proof. HACS custom-repository install/upgrade is separate from default listing. Routine existing-capacity image pulls/public advisory queries need no extra consent; inspect for private registry routing, disclose no secrets, create no new spend/accounts/credentials. Evidence generation can proceed with qualified operators and fidelity review, but domain/feature/support acceptance stays held until qualified independent review. New tests/tooling/scripts intended as deliverables need ordinary different-family review; owned operational scratch does not bypass that rule.
10. Compose accepted source sequentially, then freeze shared runner/model/client/evidence code BEFORE candidate-bound security/canonical campaigns. Preserve API034's completed bounded source review/report evaluation; M1 is a candidate-freshness hold, not a prerequisite that circularly prevents composing the candidate it must test. WS040 is a separate retained chain. Full privacy-chain acceptance remains held; source staging is not canonical admission. Original PR-merge CI records are never relabeled as branch ancestry. Run required REST fixture/registry/ledger checks serially and retain100% routes for every applicable REST change.

## Execution order and finite capacity

After actual all-three R3 adoption, first wave is FC-TRUTH (M3 inventory, Sol review staged) plus FC-PROVENANCE (Astra factual native/attempt/role audit, independent M3 inventory-fidelity review staged). Each gets only new report/owned roots, no source or canonical records. Coordinator applies accepted current-summary changes, including stale gate state, serially. Provenance audit records exact source contributions and failed-scope history for each proposed assessment, each judge, each author and primary reviewer. If the audit is incomplete, keep the affected assessment held and continue truth/support/reproduction work.

Next stagger Q-UI-A candidate/judge, Q-LC-M3 candidate/judge and Q-HA-M3 candidate/judge as their individual gates pass, alongside a qualified support/browser operator or truth review when slots permit. At most two current workers plus coordinator plus the protected external reservation, no nesting. Select exact qualified operators/judges from recorded actual evidence; no broad brand entitlement. Do not dispatch the whole backlog from one quota observation. Reserve each product author's correction and exact different-family rereview before source starts. If a route is unknown/below30%/insufficient, use only a task-qualified fallback with freshly verified headroom; otherwise hold that row, not the project. Google is unverified and DeepSeek unavailable; no new accounts, login or spend.

After source-domain reviewer PASS and author task fit, run minimal UI and HA fixes in disjoint leases; WS follows its full lifecycle reviewer gate and recorded coordinator contract lease. Review the complete composed exact commits, including coordinator-owned changed contracts/fixtures; a judge of a review does not independently accept its own family's source. New findings return to the actual author; no repeated unchanged failed gate. Then finish retained-source admission, sequential integration and frozen candidate evidence, all remaining per-unit dispositions, software RC/build/docs, and finally owner hardware/visual/continuous72h/field-week/final-release gates. No dates or total allowance are invented.

## Owner input

Only the existing exhausted privacy-attempt proposal needs an immediate explicit owner budget answer: one additional Opus5.5 assessment and one Astra judge, unchanged standards/existing accounts/no automatic retry. Approval alone would not clear provenance or qualification. Keep it pending, do not repeatedly ask or infer consent from wakes. Later decisions are an evidenced compatibility-claim change, new visual/baseline approval, actual device/topology/action/restore access and viewport measurements, continuous soak/field windows/sign-off and final version/main/tag/artifact publication. Historical data losses remain reported. No hardware or credentials are needed for current software planning/inventory.

R3 participants must inspect the same complete packet SHA and explicitly ACCEPT, REQUIRE_CHANGES or BLOCKED. Adoption requires all three ACCEPT on exactly the same bytes with no material blocker. This proposed plan deliberately retains held source/owner gates; accepting the conditional program does not assert those gates passed.
